parameters.query: SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, NULL AS slug, t.code, t.name, t.sport, NULL AS logo_url, t.logo_key, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, t.area, t.city, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 1, JSON_ARRAY(CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' divisions'),   IF(MAX(v.entry_fee) = 0, 'Free entry', CONCAT(IF(MIN(v.entry_fee) = MAX(v.entry_fee), 'Entry ₹', 'Entry from ₹'), FORMAT(MIN(v.entry_fee), 0, 'en_IN')))),   JSON_ARRAY(CASE MIN(v.format) WHEN 'LEAGUE' THEN 'League' WHEN 'KNOCKOUT' THEN 'Knockout' ELSE 'Groups + knockout' END,   IF(MAX(v.entry_fee) > 0, CONCAT('Entry ₹', FORMAT(MAX(v.entry_fee), 0, 'en_IN')), 'Free entry'))) FROM tournament_divisions v WHERE v.tournament_id = t.id) AS tags, t.status, t.entry_type, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, CASE WHEN t.status = 'LIVE' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' OR t.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS stage, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('division', d.name, 'team', tm.name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key)) FROM tournament_matches fm JOIN tournament_entries we ON we.id = fm.winner_entry_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = we.team_id JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = fm.division_id WHERE fm.tournament_id = t.id AND fm.stage = 'KNOCKOUT' AND fm.status = 'COMPLETED' AND fm.round_no = (SELECT MAX(x.round_no) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = fm.division_id AND x.stage = 'KNOCKOUT') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches x WHERE x.division_id = fm.division_id AND x.stage = 'KNOCKOUT' AND x.round_no = fm.round_no) = 1) AS champions FROM tournaments t WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND COALESCE(t.kind, 'TOURNAMENT') <> 'QUICK' AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY stage, IF(CASE WHEN t.status = 'LIVE' THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' OR t.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 2 ELSE 1 END = 2, -TO_DAYS(t.end_date), TO_DAYS(t.start_date)) LIMIT 30; SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, slug, NULL AS code, name, sport, logo_url, logo_key, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, area, city, tags, status, entry_type, 1 AS stage FROM featured_tournaments WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id
